evals.prompt: Antes de montar o plano de ação do AssinAi, confere se as recomendações das cinco lentes da revisão de design não se contradizem. Não quero corrigir uma coisa e reabrir outra.
evals.expected_output: A conflict report over all five lens reports: each conflict names the findings, the concrete collision in the code, what happens when both fixes are applied, and a resolution; trade-offs are left to the user as decisions.
assertions: Every conflict is numbered X-nnn and names at least two F-<LENS>-nnn findings that exist in the lens reports
Every conflict states where the two remediations collide, with a file path, setting or contract
Every conflict walks through what happens when both fixes are applied as written
Every conflict has a resolution of kind combined, prefer, sequence or decision
A prefer resolution says what the non-preferred finding gets instead
Product or risk trade-offs are left as decisions with options, not chosen by the reviewer
scripts/conflicts.py check exits zero: no unknown finding and no cycle in the fix order
Pairs that were checked and found compatible are listed
No lens report, plan or code file was modified

evals.prompt: do the security and ux recommendations from the review fight each other anywhere?
evals.expected_output: A conflict check limited to the security and UX lens reports, stating that only those two lenses were compared.
assertions: Only the security and UX reports are compared, and the report says so
A result of no conflicts, if that is the case, is stated plainly with the checked pairs listed
